d:
We tried to make a car completely undetectable to AI surveillance cameras like Flock and Axon. Using adversarial noise and the help from some friends, we put our car up against an actual Flock camera to see if our tricks would work.
Massive thanks to Bill Swearingen for designing our Flock-proof wrap! If you’re interested in his anti-surveillance clothing, check out
Huge thanks to His channel is amazing and he has some really cool stuff coming out about AI surveillance and cars. We couldn't have made this video without him!
